$comment: Reviewed Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon (add-privacy-preserving-analytics D4b: Cloudflare-hosted, SRI-pinned, until Cloudflare answers the self-hosting question, task 3.2). The build emits this exact integrity; browsers refuse any other bytes. Bump only after the review procedure in README.md. A weekly drift check (.github/workflows/beacon-drift.yml) compares the live file with this hash.
reviewNotes: No innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write/eval/new Function/WebAssembly; no cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage or indexedDB access; no DOM element creation. Reads the data-cf-beacon config from the current script, location.pathname/search (we strip the query and fragment first), document.referrer, navigator.userAgent and Performance API entries; reports with navigator.sendBeacon / XMLHttpRequest to https://cloudflareinsights.com/cdn-cgi/rum. History hooks (pushState) only when spa is true; we set spa:false. Response sets no cookie; ACAO * so SRI with crossorigin=anonymous works.
